Your salary must also meet an hourly floor of £17.13 and the published going rate for your occupation code — whichever of the three is highest applies.

faqs.a: New entrants qualify for a reduced threshold of £33,400 per year. You count as a new entrant if you are under 26, switching from a student or graduate visa, working toward a recognised professional qualification, or recently completed UK study. The discount lasts up to four years and cannot be renewed.

sections.content:
Every Skilled Worker application in 2026 faces a triple salary test: your pay must clear the general threshold of £41,700 per year, the published going rate for your occupation's SOC 2020 code, and an hourly floor of £17.13 across a maximum 48-hour week. Whichever is highest is the figure that binds — and in practice, the going rate is what catches most applicants out.

The £41,700 figure followed the July 2025 increase from £38,700, a jump that priced some lower-paid roles out of sponsorship entirely. For Australians comparing options, note that the Youth Mobility Scheme remains the simpler route for under-36s who do not need a sponsored professional role.
sections.title: The £41,700 Threshold Explained

sections.content:
Going rates are set per occupation and often sit above the general threshold. Software developers are near £46,000, business analysts around £44,500 and marketing managers near £48,000 — so a developer offered £43,000 still fails despite clearing £41,700. Always check the Home Office Appendix Skilled Occupations for your exact four-digit code before negotiating.

Discounts exist for specific groups. New entrants — under-26s, those switching from student or graduate visas, and people working toward recognised professional qualifications — qualify for a reduced threshold of £33,400. The discount lasts up to four years and cannot be renewed, so plan your salary progression accordingly.

sections.content:
Since July 2025, most sponsored roles must sit at RQF Level 6, equivalent to degree level. This describes the job rather than the applicant, so a self-taught developer can still be sponsored if the role's duties genuinely match a qualifying occupation code. The skill bar is about the work, not your certificates.

Your employer must hold a valid Home Office sponsor licence and assign you a Certificate of Sponsorship with a unique reference number. Check the public register of licensed sponsors before investing time in an application — if the employer is not licensed, the route is closed no matter how strong your offer is.
sections.title: Skill Level and Sponsorship

sections.content:
Start by finding a licensed sponsor with a genuine vacancy at the right skill and salary level. Your employer assigns the Certificate of Sponsorship, after which you apply online with your CoS reference, passport, proof of English at B1 level, and evidence of maintenance funds unless your sponsor certifies them.

Standard processing takes around three weeks from outside the UK, with priority services available at extra cost. Get the salary maths right before your employer assigns the CoS — a refusal over the going rate wastes both the application fee and the immigration skills charge your employer paid.
